device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD satellite PVR receiver with CA slot, Ethernet and USB WiFi/3G
device.board: DVBS2---0.1.0 / M3601 Demo / MSEE Demo (4 MB SPI dual-CPU M3601S / M3602 platform)
device.soc: ALi M3601S / M3602 dual-CPU (chip ID 0x3602; seecode runs on the SEE core at 0xA6000200)

source.author: Openbox / Skybox
source.note: Archive OPENBOX_V5S_3601HD_CMT_15051903A3.zip from the Openbox / Openbox V5S directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-07.

simulator.note: Boots as a dual-CPU M3602 board (chips/m3602.py, run_dump_openbox_v5s_app_starts.py): the bootloader ("DVBS2---0.1.0") parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1E92ECC, unpacks seecode ("MSEE Demo") to 0xA6000200 and maincode ("M3601 Demo") to 0x80000200, starts both cores, prints "\x01\x02" on UART, and exchanges bidirectional remote calls between the main CPU and the SEE co-processor (29 main->SEE calls, 16 SEE->main calls).

desc: Openbox V5S (Skybox V5S) firmware 15051903A3 (2015-05-19) for the compact Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the dual-CPU ALi M3601S / M3602 platform with 4 MB SPI flash.
Pairs bootloader "DVBS2---0.1.0" with "M3601 Demo" maincode (0x020000) and "MSEE Demo" seecode (0x210000), parking the SEE at 0xA1E92ECC before launching the SEE core at 0xA6000200.
